title: Weighted bilinear identities and supercongruences for Apéry-like polynomials
summary: We establish weighted bilinear summation identities for two families of Apéry-like polynomials $g_n(x)$ and $v_n(x)$. The identities express weighted sums in terms of consecutive endpoint values and, when necessary, lower moments. For $g_n(x)^2$ we obtain identities with weights $(2n+1)^r$ for $1\le r\le4$; for $v_n(x)^2$ we treat the cubic and quintic weights. Combining these formulas with congruences for the endpoint values gives supercongruences modulo $p^3$ and $p^4$, together with special evaluations modulo $p^5$ and $p^7$, where $p$ is a prime greater than $3$.
